client.business_model: Family-founded online and catalog retailer/wholesaler of Christian books, media, gifts and curriculum serving consumers, churches and schools worldwide.
client.client_history: Founded in 1978 by the Hendrickson family, Christianbook has grown from a garage-based bookseller into one of the world’s largest distributors of Christian products. Headquartered in Peabody, Massachusetts, the company operates a 370,000-sq-ft fulfillment center and serves millions of customers through its e-commerce site and extensive catalog mailings.

revenue.notes: Other estimation sites list $53.4M (Growjo) and $84.2M (Buzzfile). No official figures released. Reported as mid-point of public estimates; treated with low confidence.

locations.source: Christianbook.com FAQs/About page – indicates only headquarters with customer pick-up at 140 Summit St, Peabody, MA.
locations.notes: Company states it does not operate retail stores beyond its Peabody headquarters.

employees.notes: Other sources: itemlive.com (≈600 in 2020), Wikipedia (500 in 2012; 600 in 2019). Using most recent third-party listing; moderate variance across years.
